dataset： GSE163151

## **1.Dataset preparations**

```{r}
library(GEOquery)
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(factoextra)
library(ggrepel)
library(GGally)
```
1.2.Grab data

```{r}
gse <- getGEO("GSE163151")

```
1.3 Grab metadata

```{r}

metadata <- pData(gse$GSE163151_series_matrix.txt.gz)

```

1.4
```{r}

metadata <- metadata |>  
  select(
    "title"
  ) |>
  separate(
    title,
    into = c("method", "sample_id"),
    sep = "-",
    extra = "merge"
)

head(metadata)


```

1.5
```{r}
count_files <- list.files("./samples", pattern = "\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)

count_matrix_list <- map(count_files, function(file_path){
  df <- read.delim(file_path, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

  df[,1, drop = FALSE]
}) %>% 

  set_names(
    basename(count_files) %>% 
      str_remove("_counts.txt.gz")
  )

counts_merged <- do.call(cbind, count_matrix_list)

dim(counts_merged)
head(rownames(counts_merged))
head(colnames(counts_merged))


```
